title: Trump Administration Plans to Weaken Methane Leak Rules
excerpt: The administration is expected to announce plans to roll back regulations guarding against methane leaks from oil and gas companies.
body_html:
The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to announce plans to weaken regulations designed to prevent methane leaks from oil and gas companies. According to the administration's upcoming announcement, the changes will make it easier for fossil fuel companies to emit the pollutant.

Methane functions as a smog-forming pollutant as well as a powerful greenhouse gas. Over a twenty-year timeframe, it can be up to 80 times more potent than carbon dioxide. The substance serves as the primary component of natural gas.
